target17inchRatios.note: Saddle ratio is photographic estimate and adjustable. Original2–17 tire implies nominal outside diameter around(17+2*2)in=533.4mm, so OD/WB≈.533, not17in/1000mm.

preferredCompactChassis.reason: Shortening chassis fixes small-wheel impression while preserving current absolute adult/contact scale. Adjust frame/fork/contact targets together; keep immutable rider bone lengths and solve IK.

alternativeKeepWheelbase.reason: Larger wheels also require taller frame/seat/contact targets. Increasing wheels alone makes the saddle visually too low.

visualLandmarks: Long narrow enclosed engine/belt case below the step-through, with its top around axle height and pedal spindle just below/near axle height.
A slim diagonally rising pressed-steel fuel-tank spine; no large motorcycle tank.
Small single saddle on distinct seat post, rear utility rack roughly near tire-top height.
Thin wheels with narrow tires and close curved mudguards, not small scooter wheels.
